parsed.rationale: All four participating records reside in `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift` and belong to inner types named `SequentialMockSession` nested inside test classes (`LastFMArtworkServiceTests`, `DiscogsArtworkServiceTests` ×2, and `iTunesArtworkServiceTests`). Every record is therefore a test fixture by location and naming convention. Per the decision rules, any cluster where even one record has test provenance must be treated as a test-fixture no-action; here all four records are test-only. Consolidating these mock `data` implementations into a shared default would couple test infrastructure across distinct service test suites, undermining their independence as isolated fixtures.
